10a

The work done per unit mass when moving a test mass from infinity to the point.

10b

The particle moves from a higher to a lower gravitational potential, so the work done by the field is positive.

10c

Since work is done (energy is supplied to the system) to move the particle from A to B, the total work done by the two fields is negative.

question.html:
A particle of mass kg and charge is moved from point A to point B.

a. Outline what is meant by gravitational potential at a point.

   [2]

The following data are provided:

Gravitational potential at A: M J kg

Gravitational potential at B: MJ kg

Electric potential at A: mV

Electric potential at B: mV

Work done when moving the particle: pJ

b. Outline why the work done by the gravitational field on the particle is positive.

   [1]

c. Determine, in nC, the charge of the particle.

  [3]
